subject: Re: MAP kickoff — evaluation materials exchange and usage constraints
messages:

Date: 2026-09-18T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Evaluation materials request & MAP kickoff

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the quick intro earlier. Per our conversation, Novus is preparing a small test corpus and a prompt pack so your engineering team can run the evals against Redwood's hosted endpoint. We'd like to align on a mutual action plan (MAP) and some basic usage constraints before we exchange artifacts.

Quick context:
- Goal: 2-week functional evaluation to validate latency, per-token quality on our vertical prompts, and basic safety/PII checks.
- Scope: ~5k prompt cases (mix of short/long), 50 labelled golden responses for regression checks, and a small unlabelled sample (~200 examples) for throughput testing.

Questions from our side:
1) Can Redwood accept a zipped sample set (CSV manifest + JSONL prompt pack)?
2) Can you confirm permitted usage: evaluation-only, no retraining or model fine-tuning, no re-distribution outside the eval team?
3) Timeline: we'd like to start next Monday (2026-09-21) and wrap within two weeks. Any conflicts?

Attached: novus_eval_sample_manifest.csv (manifest of planned samples).

Thanks — we can propose a MAP doc if that helps.

Best,
Evelyn

Evaluation Lead, Novus AI

Hi Evelyn — thanks for the clear summary and the manifest. Happy to run this. Drafting a quick MAP and checklist — see key points below. I attached a working MAP doc and the initial prompt pack template we usually use.

High-level MAP (proposed):
- Day 0 (2026-09-21): Novus uploads sample ZIP to shared Drive; Redwood confirms receipt and verifies format (CSV manifest, JSONL prompts).
- Days 1-3: Redwood runs smoke tests and provides a baseline latency/cost snapshot and any required reformatting notes.
- Days 4-9: Full evaluation run (functional + golden response regression). Redwood delivers per-prompt scores, token counts, and failure modes report.
- Day 10: Sync to review results and next steps.

Usage constraints (Redwood standard):
- Allowed: evaluation, benchmarking, internal review by named Novus evaluators.
- Prohibited: retraining / fine-tuning, public redistribution, embedding into production systems.
- Retention: Redwood will retain the samples for 30 days post-eval unless Novus requests earlier deletion or extended retention via written agreement.
- Access: Files will be accessible only to named Novus evaluators plus Redwood delivery engineers involved in the run.

Deliverables we will provide:
- Baseline latency & cost snapshot (tokens/second, p50/p95 latencies)
- Per-prompt quality table and regression flags
- Aggregate safety and PII summary

Next steps:
1) I attached MAP_Redwood-Novus_v2.docx with the timeline and DocuSign-ready signature block.
2) If the retention window or any usage restriction needs adjustment, note it in your reply and we can update the MAP.
3) If everything looks good, upload the ZIP by EOD Monday and we'll begin.

Attachments: MAP_Redwood-Novus_v2.docx, prompt_pack_novus_v1.jsonl

Thanks — looping in Laura and Soojin for operational coverage.

—

Gabe — appreciate the flags. Confirmations below and final operational notes.

Confirmations: 
- Retention: we can shorten the default retention to 14 days for this engagement. We'll note it in the MAP doc and in the DocuSign statement of work.
- No third-party analytics: confirmed. Test runs will be executed within Redwood's secure inference environment. No sample payloads will be sent to external analytics providers. We will not log full prompt text to any external analytics. Our telemetry will only capture token-level counters and aggregated error codes for debugging unless you request deeper logs.

Operational handoff:
- Please upload the ZIP to the Drive link in the MAP doc and drop a note here once complete.
- Once received we'll run the smoke tests and post an initial receipt/compatibility report within 24 hours.
- If Novus would like an NDA amendment referencing the 14-day retention, we can append that to the DocuSign flow.

I'll sign and send the MAP via DocuSign by EOD and Laura will own the run coordination next week. Looking forward to starting Monday.
